item.text: The helper now rewrites only the authority’s hostname and removes trailing slashes from the pathname, keeping query and fragment text intact. The hook now uses that encoded URL for external-link confirmation and reports missing or unparseable link URLs. I’m reviewing the diff and then I’ll run the existing URL helper test.
